# Bucksworth Home Services

> Arizona's trusted home services company providing pest control, air conditioning, heating, plumbing, water heaters, weed control, and lawn care across 33 cities in the Phoenix and Tucson metro areas. Family-owned since 2013 by Jordan and Taylor Moore. AZ ROC #343924. Google Guaranteed. 4.84 stars from 2,000+ Google reviews.

Bucksworth Home Services serves residential customers across the Phoenix and Tucson metro areas with pest and termite control, air conditioning and heating, plumbing and water heaters, and weed and lawn care. We offer same-day service, free inspections, and a satisfaction guarantee on all work.

- Phoenix phone: (480) 422-8388
- Tucson phone: (520) 284-9930
- Website: https://www.getyourbucksworth.com
- Headquarters: 2073 W Houston Ave Suite 101, Apache Junction, AZ 85120
- Tucson Office: 3430 E Sunrise Dr Suite 180, Tucson, AZ 85718
- Licenses: AZ ROC #343924, Agriculture License #9613
- Founded: 2013
- Reviews: 4.84 stars, 2,000+ Google reviews
